_comment: Facts + choices for scripts/vehicles/standardize_vehicle.py: POLYGON Gang Warfare SM_Veh_Van_01 -> vehicles.json `cartel_van` (the Cartel van of a Heist, docs/cartel.md, #495). Positions in the SOURCE frame (faces +Z; measured, docs/research/vehicle-models-facts.md). A panel van: a cab with one bench across (cushion top y 0.94, z 0.555..1.064, backrest to z 0.25), a bulkhead behind it at z 0.271, the cargo bay from there to the rear doors (floor y 0.73, roof lining 1.87). Seats: driver behind the wheel (x 0.431, the pack's left: left-hand drive), passenger mirrored; feet = cushion top 0.94 - 0.23 like the car, at the middle of the seat (z 0.66), eye 1.0 above the feet (1.71, 0.16 under the roof lining 1.87, in the side-window band 1.33..1.80). Glass: the body glass mesh (windscreen + two front side windows) and the two rear door windows (meshes of their own under the doors). The roof rack joins the hull; the rear doors are nodes of their own (`doors`: cargo_door_l / cargo_door_r, origin on the pack's pivot = the outer vertical hinge line x 0.806, z -2.295, y 1.085 source; their window panes are children of the leaf). Lamps from the emission texture (Vehicle_01_Emission.png) under the body's UVs: headlights x +-0.673..1.012, y 0.740..0.997 on the front at z 2.531; tail lamps x +-0.839..1.010, y 0.732..1.014 at z -2.305. Skins: Vehicle_01 (white, the player's Cartel van, skin 0) and Vehicle_05 (dark, the Rival Assault van, skin 1): of Vehicle_01..06 under the pack's Textures/Vehicle, the one whose mean luminance over the van body's own UV texels (area-weighted) is lowest: 01 92.9, 02 93.6, 03 91.6, 04 95.0, 05 48.7, 06 48.8 (0..255, Rec. 709 on sRGB). The atlas PNG is copied to atlas_dir (git-ignored private pack) from polygon-gang-warfare-01/Assets/Synty/PolygonGangWarfare/Textures/Vehicle. The emission of the atlas is dropped (the lens plates are the lamps).
